author: Savagery_
body:
Hello everyone,
My username is Savagery_. When I was banned it was zirozero. Which was about...3 years ago. Honestly, I am sure none of you will believe me, but the reason I was banned was somewhat stupid. A staff member (BuyMeFallout4, had another name, he changed...can't remember what it was) was mad at me because I was "using" 'anti-knockback'... Which was complete bullshit. Pardon my language. I was lagging (the part where you wont believe me), I remember asking him to not ban me and wait a second. He didn't and went right to the ban I was going to tell him that I had severe ping(ms) problems. I was taking damage but had no idea what was happening. But, like I said earlier...this was 3 years ago. At least. So I am here today to ask any staff member that approves this message to unban me, and accept my appeal. I personally think that 3 years is long enough, I am sure many of you do too. So if you do, please take action.

Thank you,
(Savagery_)

title: Savagery_ Permanent Ban Appeal

replies.author: hcnem
replies.body:
Hello,

Your ban time has been 6 months, not 3 years. Fortunately, 6 months is also quite a significant amount of time as a banned user. Therefore, I will appeal your infraction. However, if you are banned again, your chances of being unbanned will be decreased significantly. Remember to read the rules (http://avicus.net/rules), and welcome back.

Regards,
PeachyYas | Senior Moderator
